# Docent

**AI support agent over documentation — RAG, tools, evals.** It answers questions with citations, decides which tools to call, and every change is measured by an evaluation suite.

Built with Claude Code as a coding agent: I design the architecture, review every change and own the result.

The knowledge base is the [FastAPI documentation](https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/tree/master/docs/en/docs) (MIT, see `corpus/fastapi/LICENSE`).

**Status:** day 4 of 7 — an agent decides which tools to call (search, read a page, hand off to a person); answers are generated by Claude with citations.

## Run

```bash
docker compose up -d                      # Postgres 16 + pgvector on :5435
cd backend
python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
.venv/bin/python -m app.ingest            # ~6 min on CPU: 156 pages → ~2400 chunks
.venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload   # http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests

cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run dev   # http://localhost:5173, /api is proxied to :8000
```

## Decisions

- **Chunks keep their heading path** ("Security › OAuth2 › Scopes"): it is embedded together with the text and shown as the citation.
- **Embeddings:** `BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5` via fastembed (ONNX, CPU, 384 dims) — free, local, good enough for an English corpus; queries get the BGE search instruction, passages don't.
- **Index:** HNSW on cosine distance + a generated `tsvector` column ready for the full-text half of hybrid search.
- **Streaming:** `/chat` sends Server-Sent Events (`sources` → `token`… → `done`). The UI reads them with a custom `useChatStream` hook (`fetch` + `ReadableStream`, cancellation through `AbortController`), so swapping the extractive answer for an LLM later does not touch the UI.
- **UI state:** chat history in `useReducer`, server state (retrieval panel) in TanStack Query with deferred input, shared settings in a memoised Context.
- **Generation backends** (`backend/app/llm.py`): the Anthropic SDK when `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is set (streaming, cached system prompt, server-side refusal fallback), the local `claude -p` CLI for development, or extractive answers with no model — so a fresh clone runs without credentials. Picked by `LLM_BACKEND` (`auto` by default).
- **Prompt:** numbered `<source>` blocks, every claim cited as `[n]`, "not covered" instead of answering from memory, and sources treated as data, not instructions (a guard against prompt injection through documents).
- **Agent loop is hand-written** (`backend/app/agent.py`), not a framework: a hard step budget, tool errors returned to the model as observations (unknown tool, bad input, a crashing tool), and a trace of every step stored in `traces` for evals. Hand-offs open a row in `tickets`.
- **The agent only gathers evidence; the cited answer is a separate step.** This lets the evaluation measure the tool decisions and the answer quality separately, and `mode: "rag"` (one search, no agent) stays as the baseline.
- **Planners behind one interface:** native tool use via the Anthropic SDK; a JSON-reply protocol for a model without a tools API (the local `claude -p`); and a no-model "search once" planner. The loop is unit-tested with a scripted planner — no database or LLM needed.
